Our team

Licensed therapists who know you by name.

Physical and occupational therapists and a Certified Hand Therapist, all under one roof at both offices.

Timothy Wiater

PT, DPT, OCS, MBA

Clinical Director & Physical Therapist · Royal Oak & Troy

I founded Michigan Orthopaedic Rehabilitation in 2012 with my wife, Jen. I’m a board-certified Orthopaedic Clinical Specialist with Stott Pilates training, and I’m completing my certification in Functional Manual Medicine through MSU.

Anne Chmielewski

OTRL, CHT, CLT

Clinical Director & Occupational Therapist · Royal Oak & Troy

I’ve spent 20 years treating hand and upper-extremity injuries, from fractures and tendon repairs to joint replacements. I’ve been a Certified Hand Therapist since 2009.

Joshua Wenzlaff

PT, DPT, ATC

Clinical Director & Physical Therapist · Royal Oak & Troy

I focus on manual therapy and spinal joint manipulation, and I’ve been a board-certified athletic trainer since 2015. I also teach as a clinical instructor for the University of Michigan-Flint and the University of Limerick.

Denise Dean

PT, MPT

Physical Therapist · Royal Oak & Troy

I’ve practiced outpatient orthopaedic physical therapy for more than 20 years and trained as a Stott Pilates Mat and Reformer instructor. Outside the clinic I’m an avid runner and a mother of five.

Brandi Myke

PTA, Stott Cert

Physical Therapy Assistant & Pilates Instructor · Royal Oak & Troy

I’ve worked in outpatient orthopaedic physical therapy for more than 20 years, and I teach Pilates at Body Mechanics. I’m certified in FMT Blades and FMT Blades Advanced.

Austin Kneip

PT, DPT, BRM

Physical Therapist · Royal Oak & Troy

I’ve been a physical therapist for nine years, eight of them travelling through Arizona, California, North Carolina and Washington. I’m certified in Blood Flow Restriction Training and the Barbell Rehab Method, and I work with active adults and athletes from grade school to the pros.
